articles.title: Cuba Gives Hero's Welcome to Thug 'Diplomat' Expelled from America for U.N. Attack
articles.description: Regime officials in Cuba staged a warm welcome on Thursday for Richard Tur, a former member of the country's United Nations delegation who was expelled from America this week after attacking U.S. Ambassador to the U.N.
